background: Nationwide Building Society is the largest building society in the world and the UK's second-largest mortgage lender, a mutual funded by retail savings and current accounts and lending mainly on residential mortgages, now also the owner of Virgin Money.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, all on a stable outlook, after a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. CET1 of 18.6% is above the median for UK building societies, but leverage of 5.2% is in the bottom quarter, the usual pattern for a large prime mortgage book. Liquidity is adequate, LCR of 174% below the peer median and NSFR of 145% above it, and none of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Jun 2026. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
